lead: Vivace is an RF microneedling device offered in aesthetic clinics.

paras: RF microneedling pairs needle punctures with radiofrequency energy intended to prompt skin remodeling.

lead: Vivace is a radiofrequency microneedling device used in aesthetic procedures. No registered trial or published study located for this entry names the Vivace device specifically.

Microneedling generally is a cosmetic procedure in which sterile needles repeatedly puncture the skin; Wikipedia notes uses for scarring and acne [1]. A registered 2023 trial compared facial muscle exercises with fractional microneedling radiofrequency, as a category, for facial aging [2].

paras: No studies found specifically on the Vivace device. Related category-level research: a 40-participant registered trial begun in 2023 compared facial muscle exercises with fractional microneedling radiofrequency for facial rejuvenation in people with facial aging; it is listed as completed, and its outcome data are not summarized here [2].
